hero.subtitle: Integrated control room design for monitoring, command, and operational visibility.

paragraphs: Build mission-critical control rooms with video walls, operator consoles, KVM switching, and unified monitoring of ELV and IT systems. Aptus Infotech delivers design, integration, and commissioning for 24/7 operations centers.

items.title: Video Wall Systems
items.body: High-resolution display arrays for multi-source situational awareness.

items.title: Operator Workstations
items.body: Ergonomic consoles with integrated AV and control interfaces.

items.title: Unified Monitoring
items.body: Aggregate CCTV, access, BMS, and network alerts on one platform.

items.title: Redundancy & Reliability
items.body: Architecture designed for continuous operation and failover.

items.title: Experienced Integrators
items.body: 25+ years delivering ELV and security projects for healthcare, energy, education, and public sector clients across Oman.

items.title: End-to-End Delivery
items.body: Single partner from site survey and design through installation, commissioning, and after-sales support.

items.title: Quality Products
items.body: We work with leading global brands to ensure reliable, standards-compliant ELV systems.

items.title: Local Presence
items.body: Muscat-based team providing fast response, on-site support, and long-term partnership in Oman.
